words.gloss: to the woman of graceful movement

literal: To the woman of graceful movement, there is there a unique beauty; when I look, she who has affection gently smiles.
translation: There is a unique beauty in this woman of graceful movement; for when I look at her, she smiles gently with love.
modern: மெல்ல அசையும் இயல்புடைய அவளிடம் ஒரு தனி அழகு இருக்கிறது; நான் அவளைப் பார்க்கும்போது, அவள் அன்போடு மெதுவாகப் புன்னகைக்கிறாள்.
explanation: The hero describes the subtle signs of love in his beloved. He observes that there is a unique, captivating beauty in her graceful form. This beauty becomes evident when he looks at her, as she responds not with indifference, but with a gentle, affectionate smile. The word 'pasai' here denotes love or attachment, showing that her smile is filled with affection for him.
